actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.
actions.name: capture_image

facts.text: The node constructor names it 'ros2_raspicam_node' and sets namespace='raspicam'; the topic parameters are relative to that namespace.
The constructor seeds compressed_image=True and compressed_image_topic='raspicam_compressed' as ROS parameter defaults; a deployment may override them.
The module imports CompressedImage from sensor_msgs.msg.
initialize_publisher creates a CompressedImage publisher from compressed_image_topic when compressed_image is true; the false branch references Image, which the module never imports.
take_pictures requests capture_continuous(..., format='jpeg'), and write_capture builds a CompressedImage with the captured bytes, format='jpeg' and header.frame_id set to the frame number.
publish_images takes each queued CompressedImage and publishes it unchanged on the publisher.
README documents the absolute topic /raspicam/raspicam_compressed carrying JPEG bytes in sensor_msgs CompressedImage form with header.frame_id equal to the frame number.
README states the project does not output a raw image, does not output camera info and does not accept parameters.
destroy_node closes the PiCamera object when one exists and then calls the base destroy_node.
main calls stop_workers and destroy_node only after rclpy.spin returns.
write_capture sets format and header.frame_id; its only header.stamp assignment is commented out.
The node defines its own has_parameter helper, which calls get_parameter and treats a NOT_SET type as unset, and set_parameter_defaults sets only the parameters that helper reports unset.
